g.aria-label: The 470 Ω resistor in wire 2 (J2) of the P2 cable
1. Cut wire 2 about 15 mm from its free end.
2. Slide a piece of the 3 mm tube onto the wire, clear of the cut.
3. Strip 3 mm from each cut end. Trim the resistor's leads to 5 mm each. Solder it in.
4. Slide the tube over the resistor and both joints and shrink it.
Crimp the terminal on this wire only after this.
